svg.text: Experiment 4 — what the room behind the sphere costs a calibration

What the room costs the recovered pose
worst projector position error after gauge alignment
no room, shipped floor: 21 mm
decoder modulation floor (minModulation)
pose error, mm (log)
The leftmost point of every series is the shipped decoder floor. Every seed is a dot; the line is the median of five.
Why: correspondences that never touched the sphere
share of the accepted set whose camera ray missed the ball
decoder modulation floor (minModulation)
off-sphere share of accepted correspondences
Measured against ground truth and reported only — the solver never sees it. This is the mechanism the panel on the left is explained by; without it the finding is a correlation.
And what segmentation costs it
rejecting correspondences whose projector ray misses the nominal sphere
no room, no segmentation: 21 mm
segmentation margin (fraction of the sphere radius)
pose error, mm (log)
Margin 0 tests against the nominal sphere exactly. Inflating it buys back genuine points at the limb and admits the rays that graze past the ball and land on the far wall.

The room puts 14.1% of the accepted correspondences off the sphere, and that is enough to destroy the solve: recovered pose goes from 20.6 mm to 16365 mm, a factor of 793 on the medians, which are one seed each. Paired seed by seed that is a geometric mean of 168.3 over 5 seeds, improving 4 of them and taking the seeds no worse than the worst clean solve from 1 to 5. Raising the decoder's modulation floor from 0.02 to 0.4 recovers it, and costs a capture with no room in it a factor of 2.94 on the same measure. Segmentation at a margin of 0 does not clear the two-times bar either, but it is not a null result: it takes the median from 16365 mm to 44.0 mm, a factor of 372 on the medians, against a clean baseline of 20.6 mm. Both of those medians are one seed. Paired seed by seed that is a geometric mean of 15.7 over 5 seeds, improving 3 of them and taking the seeds no worse than the worst clean solve from 1 to 3. What it does not fix is the tail: the worst of 5 seeds is still 348115 mm. The residue is the correspondences that miss the TRUE sphere and hit the NOMINAL one, which is the dependence on the answer that this test was always going to carry.
The room is a cylinder about the sphere’s axis with a flat floor and ceiling and no
furniture; both of its constants are class ASSUME and nobody has measured a gallery. It is a
floor on the effect, not a bound — see the cuts in the results file.
